name: Valentine's Day
seo_title: Valentine's Day Charcuterie Board Ideas: 9 Boards for Two
description: Valentine's Day charcuterie board ideas: a heart board for two, a giant heart for a party, salami roses, oysters and Champagne, plus keto and vegan.
answer: For two, you need less than you think: about 4 oz each of cheese and meat per person as dinner, 2 oz if dinner follows. Shape it like a heart and finish with dark chocolate.

ideas.title: The Heart Board for Two
ideas.text: A heart of Brie, aged Gouda and a salami rose, with strawberries, raspberries, dark chocolate and honey. One small board and one bottle of sparkling rosé or Pinot Noir.

ideas.title: The Galentine's Board
ideas.text: A bigger, brighter board: whipped feta, burrata, prosciutto, pink grapefruit, strawberries, pistachios and shortbread, with a pitcher of something sparkling.

ideas.title: The Chocolate Dessert Board
ideas.text: Dark chocolate, chocolate-covered strawberries, a triple-crème, salted caramels, shortbread, brandied cherries and a small pour of port.

ideas.title: The Valentine's Board for Two
ideas.text: Triple-crème brie, aged Gouda, prosciutto and Genoa salami (fold it into a rose) with strawberries, raspberries, pistachios, dark chocolate and fig jam. It all fits on a small board.

ideas.title: The Giant Heart Board
ideas.text: A big heart outlined in folded salami and filled with brie, goat cheese logs, mortadella, prosciutto and berries. It's the board for a Galentine's party or a Valentine's open house.

ideas.title: The Salami Rose Board
ideas.link_text: How to make a salami rose
ideas.text: Three salami roses made over a wine glass, set among brie, Manchego, grapes and rosemary. It takes ten minutes and looks like a florist made it.

ideas.title: Oysters and Champagne
ideas.text: A dozen oysters on crushed ice with chilled shrimp, mignonette, cocktail sauce and lemon, plus a wedge of Comté and buttered baguette. Ask the fish counter to shuck the oysters if you'd rather not.

ideas.title: Super Bowl on Valentine's Day
ideas.for: Game day meets date night · 2 guests
ideas.text: Super Bowl LXI is on February 14, 2027. If the game is on, build a game-night board for two (smoked Gouda, spicy salami, hot honey, pickles) and finish with strawberries and dark chocolate in the fourth quarter.

ideas.title: Keto or Plant-Based Date Night
ideas.text: The keto board uses Belgian endive leaves instead of crackers, with brie, Manchego, prosciutto, berries and 90% dark chocolate. The plant-based date night board has aged cashew brie, Champagne grapes, pears and dark chocolate. Both are fully planned in the library.

shapes.name: Heart Board
steps: Lay a heart outline of crackers or folded prosciutto on a round or square board.
Fill it with cheese, a salami rose and berries, keeping the reds and pinks next to the white cheeses.
Set a small bowl of chocolate or honey in the center.

plan.what: Order any specialty cheese and buy chocolate, crackers, jam and the wine.
Buy cheese, meat and berries. Chill the wine.
Wash and dry the berries and make the salami rose. Cover and chill.
Take the Gouda out of the fridge, then the Brie 30 minutes later, and build the board.

faq.q: How much charcuterie do I need for two people?
faq.a: If the board is dinner, about 4 oz each of cheese and meat per person, so 8 oz of each in total. If you're going out to dinner after, 2 oz of each per person is plenty. Two cheeses and two meats are enough.

faq.q: How do you make a salami rose?
faq.a: Fold thin salami slices over the rim of a small wine glass, overlapping each one by about half, in three or four layers. Turn the glass over onto the board and lift it off, then tuck a basil or mint leaf at the base.

faq.q: What wine goes with a Valentine's charcuterie board?
faq.a: Sparkling rosé or Champagne works with almost everything on it. For a still wine, choose a light red like Pinot Noir. If the board ends with dark chocolate, a small glass of port is the classic match.

faq.q: How do you make a heart-shaped charcuterie board?
faq.a: Outline a heart on the board with crackers or folded prosciutto, then fill it in with cheese, a salami rose and red fruit. A heart-shaped cookie cutter also turns cheese slices into hearts in seconds.

faq.q: What goes on a Galentine's Day board?
faq.a: Pretty, shareable things: whipped feta or burrata, prosciutto, pink grapefruit and strawberries, pistachios, shortbread or pink cookies, and a sparkling drink. Plan about 2 oz each of cheese and meat per guest if there's other food, 3 oz if the board is the party.

faq.q: How much does a Valentine's Day charcuterie board for two cost?
faq.a: A date-night board for two runs about $35 to $55 with two cheeses, two meats, berries and chocolate. A splurge cheese, prosciutto di Parma or a bottle of Champagne adds to that.

faq.q: How far ahead can I make a Valentine's charcuterie board?
faq.a: Shop for crackers, nuts and jars a week ahead and for cheese, meat and fruit 2 days ahead. The morning of, slice the cheese and fold the meats, then cover and chill. Build the board in the last hour, taking the Gouda out an hour ahead and the brie 30 minutes later, adding crackers last so they stay crisp.

ahead: 1 week: chocolate, crackers, jam and the wine
2 days: buy the cheese, meat and berries, and chill the wine
The morning of: wash and dry the berries and make the salami rose; cover and chill
last: Take aged Gouda out an hour before and brie 30 minutes later
Cut a heart into the brie just before it goes out

mistakes.text: For two, plan about 4 oz each of cheese and meat per person if the board is dinner, 2 oz if dinner follows. Two cheeses and two meats are plenty.
Take aged Gouda out an hour ahead and brie 30 minutes ahead, or they taste of nothing.
Dark chocolate melts into soft cheese and takes over the flavor. Give it its own corner or a small dish.

mistakes.lead: Forgetting it's also Super Bowl Sunday.
mistakes.text: In 2027 the game is on February 14. If one of you is watching, plan a board that works for both: see the game night idea above.
